meta.title: Manage Media
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Manage Media".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Manage Media', 'joomlaguide-managing-media', '

In this tour you use the Media Manager to organise images and files for a future article on telescopes: you make folders, upload, resize and rename.

The tutorial uses three telescope images and a PDF file, which you can download from it to upload. No files at hand? Every Joomla site has some space images in sampledata › cassiopeia: the tour tells you when to use them.

This tour follows the tutorial 4.2 Managing Media of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_media"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 4.2 Managing Media', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_media"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Content › Media', '

Click Media in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_media"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Media', '

The Media Manager looks like a file manager. On the left a tree with two main folders, images and files; on the right the contents of the folder you opened; above them a bar to create folders and upload.

', 3, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Create a folder', '
  1. Click images in the tree on the left.
  2. Click Create New Folder at the top of the page.
  3. At Folder Name, type Telescopes and click Create.

The new folder appears in the tree and in the contents. Clicking a folder in the contents selects it; clicking it in the tree opens it. Then click Next.

', 4, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Two sub-folders', '
  1. Click Telescopes in the tree. It opens; it is still empty.
  2. Click Create New Folder, type Optical Telescopes and click Create.
  3. Do the same for Radio Telescopes.

Then click Next.

', 5, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Go down the tree', '

Click Optical Telescopes in the tree.

The bar above the contents now shows the path: click its parts to go back up. Then click Next.

', 6, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Upload', '

Upload an image into Optical Telescopes: click Upload at the top of the page and choose an image on your computer. You can also drag more images into the contents area.

No images at hand? Skip the upload: in the next step you use an image that is already on the site. Then click Next.

', 7, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'The context menu', '

Move the mouse over an image: an ellipsis icon appears in its upper right corner. Click it to open the image\'s context menu. No image uploaded? Use nasa1-1200.jpg in images › sampledata › cassiopeia.

Editing an image changes it at once, and you cannot undo it. So first choose Download to keep a copy, if you like.

Then open the context menu again and choose Edit. When the edit page has opened, click Next.

', 8, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Resize', '

The edit page has three tabs: Crop, Resize and Rotate. Click Resize.

', 9, 'bottom', '.view-file button[aria-controls="attrib-resize"]', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media&view=file', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Width', '

For the article, all images should be 720 pixels wide: small enough to load quickly, large enough to look good.

Change the width to 720; the height follows. Then click Next.

', 10, 'right', '.view-file #jform_resize_width', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media&view=file', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Save the image', '

Click Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-file .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media&view=file', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Upload a file', '

The Media Manager handles other files too, such as PDF files.

  1. Click files in the tree, then Create New Folder: Telescopes.
  2. Click the new folder in the tree.
  3. Upload the PDF with Upload, or drag it into the contents area.

Then click Next.

', 12, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Rename and preview', '
  1. Open the context menu of the PDF, choose Rename and type the friendly name Telescopes and Light.
  2. Open the context menu again and choose Preview: the file opens in a window. Close it.

No PDF uploaded? Try it with the image you resized. Then click Next.

', 13, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-managing-media'), 'Well done!', '

Your images and file are on the site, in tidy folders, ready to use in articles: other tutorials show how.

Media is stored apart from articles. A good habit: keep the originals of your images on your own computer, as edits here cannot be undone.

', 14, 'right', '.com_media .container-main', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_media', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
